messages:
kate-arch: Quick thread — proposal to centralize a "warmup/fallback coordinator" that owns canary warmup leases and fallback arbitration across Dedicated/Hosted/Private. High level: one coordinator service maintains short-lived leases + health windows, makes fast fallback decisions, and issues prefill commands to KV cache layers. :thinking:
ajay-eng: Love the idea. Two quick concerns: (1) single coordinator = latency overhead + blast radius, (2) cross-region/private deployments might not be able to reach a central control plane.
sam-sre: For SRE, the coordinator must be survivable. Suggest local agents with a lightweight quorum/leader-election and a fallback to a regional coordinator. TTLs for leases are crucial.
miriam-eng-platform: Agreed on hybrid. Local agent owns session affinity and cache prefill; coordinator is the policy decision plane (canary thresholds, rollback policy). That keeps decision latency local while centralizing policy. :+1:
ben-runtime: Implementation notes: cache prefill should be idempotent and rate-limited. We should avoid doing full model traces during warmup — instead do short representative prefixes and metric probes. Example prefill command proto: ```
prefill {
  model: "redwood-v1-small"
  keys: ["prefill:tenant:123:ctx:0..7"]
  probe_input: "Hello"
  sampling_budget: 20
}
```

kate-arch: Tradeoffs I want to call out: 1) Strong vs eventual consistency of canary state. Strong consistency simplifies reasoning but increases cross-service latency. 2) Cost: warmups generate tokens; who pays? Might need chargeback or warmup budget per tenant. 3) Observability: need a timeline of lease grants, probe scores, fallback actions.
ajay-eng: On strong vs eventual: we can treat coordinator decisions as advisory. Local agent can apply a policy conflating coordinator advice with local telemetry. That tolerates eventual state and reduces outage coupling.
sam-sre: Operational runbook idea: if coordinator unreachable, local agent falls back to a conservative policy (reduce traffic to canary, increase sampling). Add an automated alert when fallback persists > X minutes.
miriam-eng-platform: Canary metrics contract proposal: probe types = [latency_p50,p99,completion_rate,quality_score]. Coordinator rolls a canary to N% and observes a sliding window of probe samples (configurable window length & cardinality). If quality_score drops > delta, trigger immediate reroute to baseline variant.
ben-runtime: For private on-prem: provide agent bundle with a small policy engine + optional central sync. Communication over mutual-TLS. Keep policy language small — JSON DSL with actions: {"scale_down":"variantB","prefill":true,"notify":"owner"}.
kate-arch: Fallback arbitration: prioritize low-latency safety (route to fallback) + graceful degradation (serve cached responses or smaller model) + canary rollback. Need deterministic tie-breaker when multiple fallbacks available. Suggest ranking by (latency cost, model_quality_penalty, monetary_cost) and compute score.
ajay-eng: Can we add preflight probes that run earlier in request pipeline? If probe shows degradation from a tenant's traffic slice, we can mark that slice for immediate reroute without impacting other slices.
sam-sre: We should also add a cheap shadowing mode to compare fallback quality in production silently. That will reduce noisy rollbacks.
miriam-eng-platform: UX: Console should show lease timeline, current policy, recent probe samples, and an ability to force-override coordinator decisions. Audit logs required.
ben-runtime: Edge case: simultaneous canary warmups for many tenants -> priming storm. Mitigation: global prefill rate limiter + staggered lease start times (hash-based jitter).
kate-arch: Next actions: 1) draft RFC with hybrid coordinator+local agent architecture and policy DSL (I can start). 2) add simple prefill proto + cost accounting sketch. 3) prototype local agent that honors coordinator advice and falls back conservatively. Who wants to pair on prototype? :rocket:
ajay-eng: I can pair on the prototype for the policy engine.
ben-runtime: I'll take cache-prefill + sampling stub.
miriam-eng-platform: I'll own console + telemetry schema.
sam-sre: I'll write the SLO/runbook and alert thresholds.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary pilot deployed to staging cluster 2026-03-21T13:45:10Z — warmup-coordinator v0.1 (flags: hybrid-agent=true, probe-window=30s) :eyes:
